data.name: Song of Myself
data.description: An egotist gains Alertness as a bonus feat rather than providing that feat to its master. [Variable Familiar Bonus alteration NOT IMPLEMENTED] It gains the variable familiar bonus (such as the bat's +3 bonus on Fly checks) instead of granting the bonus to its master. This alters alertness and the variable familiar bonus.
